name: B10-0025/2024 (Verts/ALE) – Situation in Venezuela
title: Resolution on the situation in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It asks Venezuela's authorities to publish the full voting records from the July 2024 presidential election and to stop repressing the opposition, releasing people held arbitrarily. It asks the European Union to work with international partners to defend democracy and the rule of law in Venezuela, to support human rights defenders and civil society, to widen asylum access for Venezuelans, and to consider targeted sanctions against those responsible for human rights abuses.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and asks others to act.
- The requests target Venezuela's authorities, the European Union and its member states.
- Next, the Council is asked to urgently consider targeted sanctions on those responsible for abuses.
